mapper.sql: select requirement_id, program_id, season, min_gpa, tiers_not_accepted, ielts_overall, ielts_min_sub, other_language, test_requirement, test_detail, prerequisites, prerequisites_required, work_years, accept_cross_major, accept_pre_sessional, deadlines, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from abr_requirement
mapper.select: where program_id = #{programId} and del_flag = '0' order by season desc
where program_id = #{programId} and season = #{season} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into abr_requirement (program_id, season, min_gpa, tiers_not_accepted, ielts_overall, ielts_min_sub, other_language, test_requirement, test_detail, prerequisites, prerequisites_required, work_years, accept_cross_major, accept_pre_sessional, deadlines, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{programId}, #{season}, cast(#{minGpa} as jsonb), coalesce(#{tiersNotAccepted}, ''), #{ieltsOverall}, #{ieltsMinSub}, cast(#{otherLanguage} as jsonb), coalesce(#{testRequirement}, 'none'), cast(#{testDetail} as jsonb), coalesce(#{prerequisites}, ''), coalesce(#{prerequisitesRequired}, 'N'), #{workYears}, coalesce(#{acceptCrossMajor}, '2'), coalesce(#{acceptPreSessional}, '2'), cast(#{deadlines} as jsonb), coalesce(#{status}, '0'), #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update abr_requirement set season = #{season}, min_gpa = cast(#{minGpa} as jsonb), tiers_not_accepted = coalesce(#{tiersNotAccepted}, ''), ielts_overall = #{ieltsOverall}, ielts_min_sub = #{ieltsMinSub}, other_language = cast(#{otherLanguage} as jsonb), test_requirement = coalesce(#{testRequirement}, 'none'), test_detail = cast(#{testDetail} as jsonb), prerequisites = coalesce(#{prerequisites}, ''), prerequisites_required = coalesce(#{prerequisitesRequired}, 'N'), work_years = #{workYears}, accept_cross_major = coalesce(#{acceptCrossMajor}, '2'), accept_pre_sessional = coalesce(#{acceptPreSessional}, '2'), deadlines = cast(#{deadlines} as jsonb), status = coalesce(#{status}, '0'), remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where requirement_id = #{requirementId} and del_flag = '0'
